catalog_nlm

Source: R/catalog_nlm.R
catalog_nlm.Rd

Return a catalog of the landscape generators in NLMR.

Usage

catalog_nlm()

Value

A tibble with one row per exported landscape generator and the columns `algorithm`, `group`, `description`, `variants`, and `reference`.

Details

The catalog is meant to help users understand the available landscape generators.

`nlm_curds()` counts as two variants because it supports both random curdling and wheyed curdling.

Examples

catalog_nlm()
